units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣现在威势比前更加隆盛，即使是微行，排场之大也不亚于行幸，越来越光彩了。

en.t: The Genji Grand Minister now had even greater power and prestige than before, and even when he traveled incognito, the splendor of his procession was no less than an imperial outing, growing ever more magnificent.

units.source_text: 太君看了他的风度，觉得这个人不像尘世间的凡人，心中赞叹不已。

en.t: When the Lady saw his bearing, she felt that he was no ordinary mortal of this dusty world, and she could not stop admiring him in her heart.

units.source_text: 因此病苦也忽然减除，坐起身来。

en.t: Because of this, her suffering from illness suddenly eased, and she sat herself up.

units.source_text: 她将身体靠在矮几上，虽然羸弱，亦颇健谈。

en.t: She leaned her body against a low table, and although she was frail, she was quite talkative.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“太君的贵恙并不很重呢。

en.t: Genji said to her, "My lady, your illness does not seem to be very serious after all.

units.source_text: 夕雾过分忧虑，向我轻事重报，我以为不知怎么样了，非常担心。

en.t: Yugiri was overly worried and reported a small matter to me as though it were grave, so I thought something terrible might have happened and was deeply concerned.

units.source_text: 拜见之后，不胜喜慰。

en.t: Now that I have seen you, I am more relieved and glad than I can say.

units.source_text: 我近来只要没有特别要事，宫中也不去，好像不是一个在朝供职的人，天天笼闭在家中。

en.t: Lately, unless there is some special business, I do not even go to the palace; as if I were not a man serving at court, I shut myself up at home every day.

units.source_text: 因此万事都很生疏，也懒得出门。

en.t: Because of that, I have grown unfamiliar with everything and have become too lazy to go out.

units.source_text: 比我年纪更大的人，也能驼腰曲背地东来西去，古往今来，其例不少。

en.t: People older than I am can still go here and there with bent backs and stooped shoulders; there have been many such examples, both in the past and now.

units.source_text: 我却奇怪，大约是本性糊涂之外又添上了懒惰吧。”

en.t: I am the strange one; perhaps laziness has simply been added to my natural foolishness."

units.source_text: 太君答道：“我知道我害的是衰老病，已经病了很久了。

en.t: The Lady replied, "I know that what I suffer from is the illness of old age, and I have been ill for a long time.

units.source_text: 今春以来，一点也不曾好转，以为不能再见到你，心甚悲伤。

en.t: Since this spring, I have not improved at all, and thinking that I might never see you again made my heart terribly sad.

units.source_text: 今日得见，我的寿命也可稍稍延长了。

en.t: Now that I have been able to see you today, my life may be lengthened a little.

units.source_text: 我现在已经不是贪生怕死的年龄了。

en.t: I am now no longer at an age when one clings to life and fears death.

units.source_text: 每次看见别人丧失了亲爱的人而独自留在世间苟延残喘，总觉得乏味。

en.t: Whenever I see someone lose a beloved person and linger on alone in this world, I always feel how dreary it is.

units.source_text: 所以我也准备早点动身。

en.t: So I too have been preparing to set out early.

units.source_text: 无奈中将对我无比亲切，异常关怀，为我的病真心担忧，因此我也顾东顾西，留在世间，一直拖延到今朝。”

en.t: But the Captain is so very kind to me, shows extraordinary care, and worries sincerely about my illness, so I too have been mindful of this and that, remaining in the world and dragging on until this morning."

units.source_text: 她说时哭泣不住，声音颤抖，令人听了觉得可笑。

en.t: As she spoke, she could not stop weeping, and her voice trembled, making those who heard her feel it was almost comical.

units.source_text: 但这确是实情，真是怪可怜的。

en.t: Yet this was truly how she felt, and it was strangely pitiable.
